- NEVER add `admit`, `assume`, `axiom`, or any unproved/fallback mechanism. No admits even for memory properties. (The platform proof policy forbids them entirely.)

- Only ADD ACSL annotations: loop invariants, loop assigns, loop variants, and (optionally) a function contract for main. No `admit`.
- Provide annotations for EVERY loop.
- Cross-loop knowledge must be carried explicitly: after loop1, a[j]==1 and b[j]==2 for all j in [0,N). Loop2 must carry that full-range knowledge and establish c[j]==3 for all j in [0,i) (full range [0,N) on completion). Loop3 must carry c[j]==3 for all j in [0,N) so the assertion c[i]>=3 is provable.
- If needed for VLA separation, declare `//@ assert \separated(...)` inside main rather than admit (Frama-C should be able to prove separate VLA declarations are separated without admit); if Frama-C cannot prove that, prefer structuring annotations to avoid needing it rather than admitting.

PRODUCE these artifacts under the specified output dir using these exact commands:

3. If it fails, inspect the WP output, locate failing goals, and iterate on the loop invariants (you may edit output/layer0/main/main.acsl.c directly and re-run verify). Iterate up to 8 rounds. When verify returns Pass with proved==total, you are done.
